SmartItem.title: SmartItem
SmartItem.description: A user-created note, task, or reminder managed by the voice assistant.

title.description: Short title of the note, task, or reminder (1-120 chars).

isCompleted.description: Completion state for tasks and reminders.

scheduledTime.description: Formatted time or date label (0-64 chars).

AutomationRoutine.title: AutomationRoutine
AutomationRoutine.description: A multi-step Android control macro triggered by voice or tap.

title.description: Display name of the routine (1-100 chars).

triggerPhrase.description: Voice phrase that activates this routine (1-120 chars).

iconName.description: Identifier for the routine icon (1-40 chars).

actionSteps.description: Bounded list of up to 10 structured action commands.

CommandLog.title: CommandLog
CommandLog.description: A historical record of a spoken command and executed Android actions.

userQuery.description: Spoken or typed command from the user (1-500 chars).

assistantReply.description: Spoken response generated by the AI assistant (1-1000 chars).

executedActions.description: Bounded list of up to 10 executed Android action summaries.

/users/{userId}/routines/{routineId}.description: Per-user voice automation routines and macros.

/users/{userId}/history/{logId}.description: Per-user voice command and action execution logs.
